evals.name: inventory-mobile
evals.prompt: Our factory inventory dashboard (Vue 3 frontend in client/) looks dated. Redesign it so it feels like a modern SaaS product: put the navigation in a vertical sidebar on the left instead of the top bar, make spacing consistent across all pages, and make sure it still works on phones.
evals.expected_output: Top nav replaced by a left sidebar holding all 6 routes with icons; language switcher, profile menu, filter bar and modals preserved and working; design tokens added and used across all views and modals; mobile drawer below ~1024px; build passes.

evals.name: inventory-casual
evals.prompt: can u move the nav links at the top into a left sidebar and make the whole app look more polished and professional? kinda stripe dashboard vibes. dont break anything pls
evals.expected_output: Same as eval 1, from a terse casual prompt with no mention of mobile or spacing; the skill should still deliver tokens, consistent spacing, every view restyled and a responsive sidebar.

evals.name: taskflow-facelift
evals.prompt: This is our little Vue 3 project management app (TaskFlow). Give it a SaaS facelift: vertical sidebar navigation instead of the purple top bar, consistent spacing everywhere, a clean professional look.
evals.expected_output: A differently structured app (<script setup>, router/index.js, TopNav.vue component, scoped styles). Sidebar replaces TopNav with all 4 routes; alerts badge, user name and logout keep working; purple brand kept; tokens used across views; Billing modal and Settings form still work; build passes.
